findings.passage: We’re not sure if this system can differentiate between those who can be issued state I.D. but are not allowed to vote.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name on the governor's plan to register people automatically when they get or renew a driver's license or state ID. She questions whether the system can screen out people who can hold a state ID but may not vote, and mentions possible licenses for undocumented immigrants.
subjects: state ID used for automatic voter registration

findings.passage: Republicans have supported using state I.D. to prove voters’ identities at the polls.
findings.note: Same statement. She says the caucus has backed using state ID to prove identity at the polls, as part of her argument about the automatic-registration plan.
subjects: state ID used for automatic voter registration
